patch_description: Crossover of the best-performing prior programs: structured inits (icosahedron+poles, Fibonacci sphere, cube+octahedron, twisted double ring) plus seeded random starts, a cheap sphere-constrained L-BFGS ranking pass with beta escalation (fast, differentiable softmin/softmax objective with analytic gradients), followed by SLSQP polishing of the top candidates on the exact constrained packing problem (maximize dmin subject to dmax ≤ 1, so dmin/dmax = dmin). Retain the free-space beta-escalation refinement and greedy perturbation polish from the 0.98-scoring script, plus a final SLSQP re-polish of the incumbent. Early-exit once the target ratio 0.2404 is reached to keep runtime bounded.
